briefdescription.para: Returns the 1-based line number of the first line in sourceText that contains propertyName as a whole word followed by optional whitespace and '='.

detaileddescription.para:
Returns 0 when no matching line is found (e.g. for a missing/nil property).
sourceText
Raw Lua source as a single string.
propertyName
The bare lua key to search for (e.g. "size", not "FONT.size").
1-based line number, or 0 if not found.
